newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB places shares in Indus Holding.
newsitem.headline: WestLB places shares in Indus Holding.

text.p: WestLB said on Thursday it and Westdeutsche Genossenschafts- Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH had sold their respective stakes of 8.9 percent and 4.4 percent in investment company Indus Holding AG to institutional investors.

The broad placement of the 1.8 million five-mark shares was conducted in a secondary offering via an international consortium of banks led by WestLB with co lead-managers Deutsche Bank AG and WGZ-Bank, WestLB said in a statement.
Indus, floated on the stock exchange in September 1995, is a holding company for small and medium-sized manufacturing businesses.
Indus has forecast a rise in 1996 group net profit to 48 million marks from 40.9 million with sales of 410 million marks, up from 365.8 million, WestLB said
